Summary of information for the web scraping exercise for nicotine pouches

Component Description
Product Nicotine pouches
Main source Rappi
Main objective Characterize the nicotine pouch market and monitor changes associated with the tax reform
Geographic coverage To be defined (e.g., Mexico City only vs. multiple cities)
Frequency To be defined
Variables to collect Price, discounts, nicotine content, pouch count, flavours, combos, store name
Additional metadata URL, date of extraction, city/location
Operational considerations Product information may appear only in product names or may be missing
Keywords bolsa nicotina; pouch nicotina; sachet nicotina; combo zyn; combo velo; zyn; velo

Summary of information for the web scraping exercise for beer

Component Description
Product Beer
Main source Soriana
Main objective Analyse alcohol content in the beer market in Mexico.A secondary objective may be to characterize market for non-/low-alcohol beer and mixed beer products (RTDs).
Geographic coverage To be defined (e.g., Mexico City only vs. multiple cities)
Frequency To be defined, depending on expected price variability and feasibility.
Variables to collect Price, discounts, alcohol content, product size/content, combos, flavours, store name
Additional metadata URL, date of extraction, city/location
Operational considerations Product information may appear only in product names or descriptions may sometimes be missing. Reported alcohol content may also be inconsistent across fields or images, potentially requiring a consistency check for a subsample of products.
Keywords Cerveza; combo cerveza; cerveza sin alcohol; cerveza cero; cerveza preparada
